title: automation: an elevated screen flow cannot declare who may start it, so apps gate on current_user.positions inside the flow
body:
Ruled: 6377848497 · batch #9 item 5 · letter A · 2026-10-24T00:43:45Z (flow-level `requiredPermissions` checked on every start door; action door inherits it; triage asked to consider p1)

## What the app needs

hotsrm (an SRM app on 18.0.0) has a "verify bank account" screen flow, `srm_bank_verify`. Only AP accountants may run it, and the person who created the account may not verify it (four-eyes). The flow writes `status` and `verified_by`, which are `readonly` for everyone, so it is `runAs: 'system'`.

## What the platform offers today

- The action that launches it can carry `requiredPermissions` (ADR-0066 D4), but that gate applies only at the action door (`POST /actions/:object/:action`).
- After #22310, the trigger door (`POST /automation/:name/trigger`) refuses elevated **self-triggered** flows, but by design still admits every signed-in member to an elevated `screen` flow ("an author who wants members to start elevated logic declares the target `screen` or `api`", `action-execution.ts`).
- `FlowSchema` has no key that says which capability, permission set or position may start the flow.

So any member can start `srm_bank_verify` through the trigger door with a `recordId`. The only defence the app can write is a `decision` node at the top of the flow: `'srm_ap_accountant' in current_user.positions`. The platform's own guidance says the positions array "is not an authorization input", so the app is relying on something the platform tells it not to rely on.

## Wanted

- A flow-level declaration of who may start it, for example `requiredPermissions: ['srm_verify_bank_account']` on the flow, checked on **every** start door (action door, trigger door, MCP `run_action`), with the ADR-0112 refusal envelope.
- A `subflow` call from a parent run keeps working.
- Optional: the action door could inherit the flow's declaration so an app does not state it twice.

## Acceptance

A screen flow declared `runAs: 'system'` with `requiredPermissions: [X]`: a member without X is refused `403` at the trigger door and the action door; a member with X starts it; `os validate` documents the key.

## Duplicate check

Searched issues for "flow requiredPermissions", "screen flow runAs system who can start". Closest: #22310 (closed; covered self-triggered flows, left screen flows open on purpose) and #25446 (no-self-approval switch on approvals; related to the four-eyes half, not to who may start).

hotsrm workaround, documented as temporary: `src/core/flows/bank-account/bank-verify.flow.ts` gates on `current_user.positions` inside the flow.
